The Battle of Karlebylånga () occurred on 18 March 1318 when an army under Birger Magnusson encountered a stronger peasant army. Instead of engaging, Magnusson decided to begin negotiations for a truce, but then when a large part of the peasants went home, he attacked and killed those who remained.
